name: Cynthia
source:
Cynthia's determination and drive were the main factors that allowed such a hot mess to become a director. She's hot-headed and is constantly teetering on the edge of an outburst. She completed an impressive 34 minutes of anger management counseling before she stormed out of the room and threw a wall painting on the floor.

She's willing to do whatever it takes to catch unlawful criminals and sometimes her temper comes in handy out in the field. She knows how to let loose on the weekends and fiercely defends those close to her but isn't afraid to hurt her colleagues' feelings with her brutal honesty. "Take it or leave it."
